newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Internatio-Mueller sees more profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Internatio-Mueller sees more profit growth.

text.p: Transport and trading company Internatio-Mueller NV said on Thursday it expected profits to grow in the future.
The company earlier posted 1996 net profit of 98.1 million guilder, up from 85.1 million in the previous year. Analysts had expected 1996 net profits of between 91 and 98 million guilders.
"We expect further growth of activities through acquisitions and through organic growth," it said.
But the company said pressure on operating profits would increase because of higher tax.
"Net profits are expected to increase further," it added.
